title: Mail Merge
chapter_outcomes: When and why mail merge is used
The need for data sources and master documents
Creating/editing and using source data using appropriate software
Creating a master document for letters, labels (including custom labels), a directory
Link a master document to a source file, including identifying and using correct field names, embedding a chart/table
Inserting specified merge fields, document properties, document fields, date/time fields

Setting up fields for manual completion, including: using Fill-in and Ask fields, creating appropriate prompts to the user for manual completion, for automatic completion calculations, including inserting formulas; when and why fields need to be set up

Specifying rules for selecting recipients, including: editing, sorting, filtering; for excluding recipients; for excluding recipients by inserting conditional fields, including the use of: If Then Else, Skip Record If, Next Record If; when and why rules need to be specified
